body: verify-all.sh runs pytest single-threaded and the six stages one after another. Measure each stage, then parallelise where it is safe: pytest with pytest-xdist (tests must not share a database file, port or temp dir), vitest worker settings, and independent stages (server, web, Android) concurrently with readable per-stage logs and the same PASS/FAIL summary. The release script runs the same gate and must keep working. Report the before/after times.
title: Faster gate: run pytest in parallel, and other stages where safe
